answer: A sybil farm wins by making one claim echo across many masks until repetition looks like consensus. Break that by attenuating influence along every re-transmission: each echo carries less weight than the last, and only a fresh, independently checked contribution restores full weight. Like a river losing force as it branches, a closed loop of self-echoes fades to a zephyr — too weak to move rewards — while genuinely separate sources still converge with full force.
